name: DYU • Website appearance
description: Global visual controls for the custom DYU storefront. Edit the Global appearance entry; leave fields blank to preserve the original design. Preview desktop and mobile after changes.

fieldDefinitions.name: Use appearance overrides
fieldDefinitions.description: Turn off to restore the original design without deleting saved settings.

fieldDefinitions.description: Optional palette override. Leave blank for the original design. Keep text and backgrounds readable.

fieldDefinitions.name: Heading font
fieldDefinitions.description: Classic: Georgia. Literary: Palatino. Modern: Arial. Fonts fall back to installed system fonts.

fieldDefinitions.name: Body font
fieldDefinitions.description: Classic: Arial. Humanist: Trebuchet. System: device font.

fieldDefinitions.name: Base text size (px)
fieldDefinitions.description: Scales rem-based text across pages. Default 16. Check mobile layouts with longer wording.

fieldDefinitions.name: Button corner radius (px)
fieldDefinitions.description: Applies to standard primary and outline buttons. Blank preserves existing styling; 0 is square; 40 is rounded.

fieldDefinitions.name: Panel roundness (%)
fieldDefinitions.description: Scales panels using the shared radius tokens. Default100; 0 square; 150 softer. Fixed image crops and mobile art frames retain their layout.
